text: MongoDB 8.0 introduced autoCompact, which enables a background process that periodically visits collection files and attempts compaction when enough space is recoverable. It automates space reclamation within existing storage rather than provisioning more disk capacity. (high confidence)

text: Treat reclaimed bytes as workload- and file-layout-dependent rather than guaranteed: MongoDB describes the compact command as attempting to reduce disk space and says its effectiveness depends on how many blocks are available to release and their location in the data file; autoCompact runs the same compaction in the background.
